findings.text: root_path is interpolated into a regex pattern without re.escape(), so special characters like '.' or '*' in root_path are treated as regex metacharacters. For example, if root_path is 'api.v1' and scope['path'] is 'apiXv1/foo', the '.' matches 'X' and incorrectly strips 'apiXv1', returning '/foo' instead of the original path.
